chunks: So We opened up the earth and sunk him and his mansion. There was not a body that could help him against (the will) of God, nor was he able to save himself.
ai.seo_question: Who was sunk into the earth by Allah along with his mansion?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as a paradigm of divine retribution against tyrants, with many scholars identifying the subject as Pharaoh or specifically Qarun (Korah) due to the mention of his 'dwelling' sinking. It underscores the concept of 'fasc' (sinking) as a unique form of punishment where the earth swallows the oppressor and his material wealth, demonstrating that worldly power is futile without divine support. This event serves as a historical precedent for the eventual triumph of the righteous over their oppressors, a core theme in Shia eschatology.
